items.summary: Disposition: blocked for public launch, security-sensitive releases, rights-dependent changes, and monetization expansion; conditional for ordinary reversible growth that adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, new data collection, or cross-site behavior and preserves consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, affiliate, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries. Current evidence: compliance is technical-only with 35 pass, 18 fail, and 6 unknown; analytics quality is yellow; operations and fleet-doctor sweeps are unavailable; revenue is limited to 2026-09-21 Amazon results of 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission that is not site-attributable. Do not claim certification, ROI, margin, forecast, or causal lift. Keep complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net parked, private, preview-only, and unlaunched. Next actions are evidence-specific: complete the existing SearchWoot evidence bundle, attach dated readiness packets for the parked sites, and complete or justifiably close the retained saveusfarms.com failure by 2026-09-30T07:30Z.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 remain open. No task is closed because direct evidence is still missing for source rights, field-level permissions, retention, deletion/correction/access, notification consent, GA4 settings, vendor coverage, incident procedures, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback. Woot API deal and price-history use is blocked; user alert rules and sync results, GA4 analytics, and operational logs/Cloudflare data are evidence_needed. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only bundle containing the field-level rights matrix, deployed data-flow and retention table, log/vendor/incident/request inventory, consent and GA4 configuration capture, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence. Keep rights outreach unsent pending human-counsel review and owner authorization.

Data-use review: Woot API deal and price-history data is blocked; missing written permission or an API agreement plus field-level limits for fetch, storage, derivatives, caching, display, alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademarks, images, prices, affiliate use, and advertising. Smallest next action: complete the internal counsel packet and obtain human-counsel review. User alert rules and sync results are evidence_needed; missing data inventory, identifiers, retention, deletion/correction/access, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. Smallest next action: produce a read-only deployed/repository data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics is evidence_needed; missing deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property/data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional review. Smallest next action: capture consent and GA4 configuration evidence without enabling new tracking. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data are evidence_needed; missing log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor coverage, incident handling, subpoena handling, and data-subject-request procedures. Smallest next action: produce a read-only log/vendor/incident/request inventory.

The three read-only control-plane specifications may remain deferred and are conditionally acceptable from a legal-risk perspective because they do not require new data collection, production mutation, monetization, permissions, dependencies, or external sharing. Do not admit implementation until capacity, security evidence, and failed-work containment reopen. Any prototype must preserve existing consent, disclosure, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, affiliate, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries and must not treat unavailable telemetry as zero.
